pattern_name: Multi-Tier Adaptive Sort Dispatch (DuckDB 2025 Sort Redesign)
variant_desc: unconditional qsort on 1M ints -> 3-tier adaptive: pre-sorted-run detection, counting sort for small range, qsort fallback (variant 4: seed=46, n_scale=0.7x)
source_citation: DuckDB blog 'Sorting Again' (2025-09-24); reported 10x speedup on already-sorted input.
novelty_rationale: Tests recognition that comparison-based sorts (qsort) leave dramatic performance on the table when the input has detectable structure: an already-sorted run can be returned in O(n) scan, a descending run reverses in O(n), and a small-range input distributes via counting sort in O(n + R). Compilers cannot perform runtime input characterization and algorithm dispatch -- they emit one fixed sort implementation.
